definitions.gloss: to corner; to drive into a corner; to push to the brink
definitions.explanation: To chase or pressure someone until they have no escape or options left. Used both literally (physically cornering) and figuratively (emotionally or psychologically pushing someone to their limit).

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{追|お}い{詰|つ}めた。
⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}い{詰|つ}められて→追い詰められる：17335_oitsumerareru⟧⟦{苦|くる}しんでいる→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧。
examples.english: I'm suffering, driven into a corner by debt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{追|お}い{詰|つ}めすぎる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れて→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧しまう。
examples.english: If you push yourself too hard, both your mind and body will break down.

notes:
{追|お}い{詰|つ}める is a transitive ichidan verb formed from ⟦{追|お}う→追う：02016_ou⟧ (to chase) + ⟦{詰|つ}める→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧ (to pack in, to close in).

ASPECT (ている):
{追|お}い{詰|つ}めて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes the ongoing process of cornering someone. ⟦{追|お}い{詰|つ}められている→追い詰められる：17335_oitsumerareru⟧ describes being in a cornered state.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- A⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{追|お}い{詰|つ}める (corner A)
- A⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追|お}い{詰|つ}められる (be cornered by A)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{追|お}い{詰|つ}める (corner a criminal)
- ⟦{精神的|せいしんてき}→精神的：05851_seishinteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追|お}い{詰|つ}める (push someone psychologically)
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{追|お}い{詰|つ}める (push oneself too hard)
- ⟦{追|お}い{詰|つ}められた→追い詰められる：17335_oitsumerareru⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧ (a cornered situation)

The passive form {追|お}い{詰|つ}められる is very common, describing the experience of being under extreme pressure.
